trap.label: ought to
trap.right: It ought to have been checked.
trap.why: Em português “deveria” é uma forma só. Em inglês, ought é seguido de to, o que o aluno esquece (diferente de should).

fix.right: Errors must be reported at once.

fix.wrong: Having reviewed the data, a pattern was found.
fix.right: Having reviewed the data, we found a pattern.

fix.wrong: Results suggests that it may be.
fix.right: Results suggest that it may be.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com ought to: “It should have been checked.”
rewrite.answer: It ought to have been checked.

rewrite.prompt: Reduza com Having: “After we reviewed the data, we wrote.”
rewrite.answer: Having reviewed the data, we wrote.

rewrite.prompt: Suavize: “Results show it is true.” (suggest, may)
rewrite.answer: Results suggest it may be true.
